gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kantumruy-pro: Bruno Ace draws every character with a ruler-straight, constant-width line and lets each one linger. Kantumruy Pro is the quieter partner, its sans-serif letterforms free of hairlines and swells, with an e that opens clearly to the right.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kodchasan: Expressive from the first letter. Bruno Ace gives headings a ruler-drawn line and a lingering, one-character-per-beat stride, while Kodchasan, a plain sans, keeps text clean with open terminals and no calligraphic thinning.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kosugi: Distinctive, straight away. Kosugi's wire-bent letters carry a text with an open-jawed c, and Bruno Ace's connected counters and ruler-drawn line keep the heading well apart from them.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kosugi-maru: Bruno Ace brings a ruler-drawn line and counters that stay open to the outside. It does its best work as a heading, while Kosugi Maru, a sans-serif with neon-tube letters and far-apart stroke ends, handles the text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-kumbh-sans: Stretched, deliberate, a little futuristic up top, with Bruno Ace lingering over every character on a ruler-drawn line. Kumbh Sans stays quiet below, so give it a modest size.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-lato: Bruno Ace has a constant-width outline you could trace with a finger, and it earns its keep big and short. Lato, a sans-serif with wide, barely curled s curves, stays low-key underneath.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-libre-franklin: Bruno Ace holds a marker-like, constant-width line, with counters that stay connected to the outside and a lingering rhythm. Libre Franklin, a sans-serif with a splayed c terminal, stays low-key beneath it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-livvic: Approachable Livvic, a sans-serif with no stress in its curves and a generous c, sits under a Bruno Ace heading. And that heading, with its ruler-drawn line and one-character-per-beat rhythm, supplies all the expression.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-lunasima: Bruno Ace has a marker-drawn plainness in every character, with counters that stay connected to the outside. And Lunasima, a sans with c tips that never creep toward touching, does the quieter work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-lxgw-marker-gothic: Wire-bent heading, soft-edged body. Bruno Ace holds strokes as constant as bent wire, while LXGW Marker Gothic, a sans with a wide-open c, adds a smooth, lightly modulated feel without any harsh thin spots.
